corrections.tag_ownership: Occupied capacity is at most one ring (RING_DWORDS), including the exactly-full boundary; extended SOP tags span two ring lengths. A new four-word parser step requires sufficient capacity after any same-edge retirement. No valid concurrently resident span exceeds one ring. Numeric tag reuse after global invalidation does not preserve prior ownership.
corrections.closure_order: Fresh closure cache override and visible_commit update occur in the same nonblocking-assignment edge. Retirement samples the old frontier and old cache on that edge, so the new committed frontier is observable only together with the fresh cache result at a later sampling edge. The original phrase before visible_commit advances describes this observation relation, not procedural execution order.
